# Meridian operations

FIXTURE PAGE — fictional company, used only by the context-compiler tests.

## Installation crews

Two crews cover DACH and one covers the Nordics. A crew can complete at most three installations a
week, which is the real ceiling on how fast new customers can be onboarded, independent of sales.

## Support hours and escalation

Support is staffed 07:00–18:00 CET. Anything that stops a production line escalates to the on-call
engineer immediately, and the CEO is told the same day. See [pricing.md](pricing.md) for how support
commitments interact with the plan a customer bought.

## Spare parts inventory

We hold six weeks of spare sensor modules. That buffer is the only thing between a supplier delay and
a stopped installation schedule.
